verdict.rationale: Metronome documents invoice creation (including auto-generating invoices in Stripe) and generic custom fields on objects, but the evidence pack has no mention of credit notes, receipts, sequential invoice numbering, or memo fields tied to compliance requirements. missing for 10: credit note generation, receipt issuance, sequential/compliant numbering scheme, invoice-specific memo fields, and evidence of automatic delivery to customers beyond the Stripe hand-off.
